bm: Bm is solid excretory product evacuated from the bowels.
Bm can also mean a euphemism for defecation.
Bm means the same as fecal matter or faecal matter or feces.
bmdo: BMDO is an agency in the Department of Defense that is responsible for making ballistic missile defense a reality.
BMDO means the same as Ballistic Missile Defense Organization.
bmi: BMI is a measure of someone's weight in relation to height.
BMI means the same as body mass index.
bmr: BMR is the rate at which heat is produced by an individual in a resting state.
BMR means the same as basal metabolic rate.
bmus: BMus is a bachelor's degree in music.
BMus means the same as Bachelor of Music.
